  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.

Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.

2021 Honda Civic LX Vehicle DescriptionIntroduction

The 2021 Honda Civic LX is a stylish, fuel-efficient, and dependable compact sedan that continues to set the benchmark for reliability, comfort, and long-term value. Known for its modern design, impressive fuel economy, spacious interior, and excellent driving dynamics, the Civic remains one of the most popular vehicles on the road and one of the smartest choices for drivers seeking a practical yet enjoyable daily driver.

Honda engineered the Civic to provide a premium driving experience without sacrificing affordability. Whether you're commuting to work, driving around town, taking long highway trips, or purchasing your first vehicle, the Civic LX delivers exceptional comfort, outstanding reliability, and the peace of mind that comes with owning one of the most trusted names in the automotive industry.

Performance

  • Engine: 2.0-Liter i-VTEC 4-Cylinder

  • Horsepower: 158 HP

  • Torque: 138 lb-ft

  • Transmission: Continuously Variable Transmission (CVT)

  • Drivetrain: Front-Wheel Drive (FWD)

  • Fuel Economy: Up to 30 MPG City / 38 MPG Highway

  • Smooth and Responsive Handling

Under the hood, the 2021 Civic LX is powered by Honda's proven 2.0-liter i-VTEC engine producing 158 horsepower and 138 lb-ft of torque. This reliable powertrain offers an excellent balance of performance and fuel efficiency, making it ideal for both city driving and long-distance travel.

The CVT transmission provides smooth acceleration and optimized fuel economy, while Honda's well-tuned suspension and steering deliver a comfortable yet sporty driving experience. The Civic is known for feeling more refined and responsive than many competitors in the compact sedan segment.

Its lightweight design and excellent handling characteristics make it easy to maneuver, park, and enjoy behind the wheel every day.

Interior & Comfort

  • Seating for 5 Passengers

  • Premium Cloth Seating

  • Automatic Climate Control

  • Spacious Rear Seating Area

  • Adjustable Driver's Seat

  • Fold-Down Rear Seats

  • Large Cabin with Excellent Passenger Space

  • Quiet and Comfortable Interior

Step inside the Civic LX and you'll immediately notice its spacious and modern cabin. Honda designed the interior to maximize passenger comfort while maintaining a sleek and contemporary appearance.

The front seats are supportive and comfortable, while rear passengers enjoy generous legroom and headroom rarely found in compact sedans. The cabin layout is clean, intuitive, and driver-focused, placing all controls within easy reach.

The Civic also offers excellent visibility and a surprisingly quiet ride, making daily commutes and road trips more enjoyable for everyone on board.

Technology & Infotainment

  • 5-Inch Color Display Screen

  • Bluetooth Hands-Free Calling

  • Bluetooth Audio Streaming

  • USB Connectivity

  • Multi-Angle Rearview Camera

  • Steering Wheel Mounted Controls

  • Automatic Headlights

  • Digital Driver Information Display

The 2021 Civic LX comes equipped with modern technology designed to keep drivers connected and informed. Bluetooth functionality allows hands-free communication and wireless music streaming, while the multi-angle rearview camera improves visibility and confidence when reversing.

The intuitive infotainment system is easy to operate and provides quick access to important vehicle information, entertainment features, and connectivity options.

Honda's thoughtful technology integration helps make every drive more convenient and enjoyable.

Safety & Driver Assistance

  • Honda Sensing Safety Suite

  • Collision Mitigation Braking System

  • Road Departure Mitigation System

  • Adaptive Cruise Control

  • Lane Keeping Assist System

  • Forward Collision Warning

  • Lane Departure Warning

  • Multi-Angle Rearview Camera

Safety is one of the biggest highlights of the 2021 Civic LX. Honda includes the Honda Sensing suite of advanced driver-assistance technologies as standard equipment, providing drivers with added confidence and peace of mind.

These intelligent systems continuously monitor traffic conditions and can assist in avoiding potential hazards. Features such as Adaptive Cruise Control and Lane Keeping Assist help reduce driver fatigue during long highway drives.

The Civic's strong safety ratings and advanced engineering make it one of the safest compact sedans available.

Cargo & Practicality

  • Spacious Trunk Capacity

  • 60/40 Split Folding Rear Seats

  • Wide Trunk Opening

  • Practical Everyday Storage Solutions

  • Excellent Daily Driver Utility

The Civic offers impressive cargo space for a compact sedan. The trunk easily accommodates luggage, groceries, backpacks, sports equipment, and everyday essentials.

The folding rear seats provide additional versatility when transporting larger items, making the Civic highly practical for work, school, travel, or family use.

Its combination of passenger comfort and cargo flexibility makes it one of the most well-rounded vehicles in its class.

Exterior Features

  • Sleek Aerodynamic Design

  • LED Daytime Running Lights

  • Automatic Headlights

  • Body-Colored Exterior Trim

  • Modern Honda Front Grille

  • Stylish Wheel Design

  • Sporty and Contemporary Appearance

The exterior of the 2021 Civic LX features a bold and modern design that continues to look fresh and stylish. Sharp body lines, an aggressive front fascia, and a low, athletic stance give the Civic a premium appearance that stands out in the compact sedan segment.

Its aerodynamic profile not only enhances its visual appeal but also contributes to improved fuel efficiency and a quieter ride.

The Civic's sporty yet sophisticated styling makes it equally appealing to young drivers, professionals, and families alike.

Highlights

  • Honda Sensing Safety Suite

  • Excellent Fuel Economy

  • Proven Honda Reliability

  • Spacious Interior

  • Comfortable Seating for 5

  • Bluetooth Connectivity

  • Multi-Angle Backup Camera

  • Smooth CVT Transmission

  • Low Cost of Ownership

  • Strong Resale Value

  • Comfortable Daily Driver

  • One of the Best-Selling Sedans in America

Summary

The 2021 Honda Civic LX is a smart, dependable, and fuel-efficient sedan that delivers exceptional value, modern safety technology, and long-term reliability. With its spacious interior, comfortable ride quality, advanced Honda Sensing safety features, and impressive fuel economy, the Civic continues to be one of the best choices in the compact sedan market.

Whether you're searching for a dependable commuter vehicle, a first car, a family sedan, or a stylish daily driver, the Civic LX offers the perfect combination of practicality, comfort, efficiency, and reliability. It's a vehicle built to serve you well for years to come while making every drive enjoyable.

Entertainment and connectivity are seamlessly integrated with HondaLink smartphone app compatibility, allowing for remote engine start and cabin preconditioning. The vehicle features a 8-inch touch screen with HD radio, Pandora internet radio, and a premium 9-speaker audio system producing 450 watts of power. Hands-free voice-operated calling and radio controls, along with wireless phone charging, provide convenience, while Apple CarPlay and satellite radio readiness enable versatile media options. The Accord’s infotainment system is designed for easy access and intuitive use, making every drive enjoyable. Performance is optimized with electronic suspension control and driver-adjustable ride control, allowing customization of the driving experience. The combination of advanced suspension technology and responsive powertrain makes this Honda Accord Touring a compelling choice for those seeking a well-equipped, stylish, and reliable sedan. 2021 Honda Accord Safety and Security Features This model comes equipped with a rear seat reminder, dual front knee airbags, traffic sign recognition, front and rear parking sensors, four-wheel ABS, anti-lockout power door locks, cornering brake control, auto-locking power door locks, and an electronic parking brake with auto-off. These features work together to enhance safety, prevent accidents, and provide peace of mind for all occupants. 2021 Honda Accord Entertainment and Technology Features The Accord features HondaLink compatibility for smart device app integration, along with voice-operated hands-free calling and radio functions. It includes HD radio, Pandora internet radio, and a touchscreen infotainment system with an 8-inch display and 9 speakers delivering 450 watts. Additional convenience features include engine start and cabin preconditioning via smartphone app, making every drive connected and enjoyable. 2021 Honda Accord Performance Features The vehicle’s electronic suspension control and driver-adjustable ride control allow for a tailored driving experience. This setup provides a smooth, controlled ride, whether you're cruising on highways or navigating urban roads, ensuring comfort and stability at all times.
